messages:
Rae (Design): Quick copy review for the 'Pin model version' confirmation modal. Current title: `Pin version` and body: `Pinning prevents automatic model updates.` Feels terse and users asked what happens to rollbacks/canary and billing.
Owen (PM): We need to surface two things: 1) pinned deployments won't receive automatic updates, and 2) pinning doesn't change the model's billing tier but may affect fallback behavior. Keep it short.
Mina (Copy): Draft body options:
A) "Pin this deployment to model vX. This prevents automatic updates; you can unpin later."
B) "Lock this deployment to model vX. It will not auto-update; rollouts must be manual. Billing is unchanged."
Dev (Eng): Accurate note: pinning only disables auto-rollouts; automatic fallback to compatible variants still works if explicitly enabled. Also we have a canary route concept — maybe say "rollouts must be manual (including canary)".
Kai (A11y): For screen readers, avoid words like "lock" which may imply permission changes. Use "pin" or "pin to version". Also add aria-describedby that includes the exact version ID and the phrase "cannot be undone by auto updates".
Rae (Design): Visual constraint: modal can only hold ~3 short lines. Suggest title "Pin this model version?" Body: two short sentences and a small gray line with a link to docs.
Mina (Copy): Proposed concise microcopy:
- Title: "Pin this model version?"
- Body: "Pin deployment to model vX. It will not receive automatic updates; rollouts and unpinning must be done manually. Billing is unchanged."
- Link: "See how pinning and rollouts work"
- Primary CTA: "Pin version" (danger? maybe neutral)
- Secondary CTA: "Cancel"
Owen (PM): Primary action shouldn't be danger — pinning is reversible. Use neutral primary and secondary as normal.
Dev (Eng): Implementation: modal component supports `detail_line` for the small gray text. We'll include the version identifier in `aria-describedby` so SR users hear which version.
Kai (A11y): Add aria-label on primary CTA: "Pin deployment to model vX" and ensure when the modal opens focus lands on Cancel by default to avoid accidental pinning. Also announce with aria-live: "Pin modal opened for model vX".
Rae (Design): Agreed on focus order and neutral CTA. I'll update Figma and annotate the dialog for focus/fallback.
Mina (Copy): I'll add the finalized copy to /docs/microcopy/confirmations.md and include the aria examples:
- button aria-label: `Pin deployment to model vX`
- aria-describedby: `pin-modal-desc-vX`
Owen (PM): Sounds good. No objections, marking ready for a small PR to change labels and add ARIA attributes.
Dev (Eng): I'll pick up the PR tomorrow and wire the aria-describedby to include the version string.
